Most land cover classifiers are trained on labelled data from where the researchers live, mostly North America and Europe. Apply them in Africa or Asia and villages become informal settlements, traditional farms become wasteland. The fix is regional training data and community validation.

#RemoteSensing #MachineLearning #GIS

I'm Joseph, a geospatial scientist (PhD, Earth System Science). I explain what satellites see, in plain words. Videos: youtube.com/@Routero
